root_cause: The sweep fires on a False->True edge of the zone's vacancy_sweep_done flag when the zone is lighting-vacant and past the vacancy grace. Most fires do nothing: of 187 fires in 7 days, only 10 saw any swept entity go on->off within 15 s (about 5%), and those were chiefly person-switched lights/relays in vacant automated rooms plus a few HVAC-owned fans. It is not broken and not fighting occupants (it never fires while a room is lighting-occupied). The per-zone sweep opt-out is overwritten by the global 'Vacancy Auto-Off' switch at startup.
